commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-none} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-none} ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-none}"; git status --porcelain | head; echo "---PRVIEW---"; gh pr view 1144 --json headRefName,baseRefName,baseRefOid,headRefOid,title,body,state,url --jq '{head:.headRefName,base:.baseRefName,baseOid:.baseRefOid,headOid:.headRefOid,state:.state,url:.url,title:.title}'

for f in .github/workflows/devflow-implement.yml .github/workflows/devflow.yml .github/workflows/devflow-runner.yml; do echo "=== $f ==="; git show e28dc036:$f 2>/dev/null | grep -niE 'vendor_marketplace|compose-vendor-marketplace|1049|vendored subtree|vendored-marketplace|vendored marketplace' || echo "(none)"; done

for f in .github/workflows/devflow-implement.yml .github/workflows/devflow.yml .github/workflows/devflow-runner.yml; do echo "=== $f ==="; git show "e28dc036:$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -niE 'vendor_marketplace|compose-vendor-marketplace|1049|vendored sub|vendored-marketplace|vendored marketplace' || echo "(none)"; done

git show e28dc036:.github/workflows/devflow-implement.yml > /tmp/impl.yml; git show e28dc036:.github/workflows/devflow.yml > /tmp/dev.yml; git show e28dc036:.github/workflows/devflow-runner.yml > /tmp/run.yml; echo done

for f in devflow-implement devflow devflow-runner; do echo "=== $f.yml ==="; git grep -c -F 'plugin_marketplaces: ${{ steps.plugins.outputs.plugin_marketplaces }}' e28dc036 -- .github/workflows/$f.yml; done

for f in devflow-implement devflow devflow-runner; do n=$(git show e28dc036:.github/workflows/$f.yml | grep -c -F 'plugin_marketplaces: ${{ steps.plugins.outputs.plugin_marketplaces }}'); echo "$f.yml: $n"; done

for f in devflow-implement devflow devflow-runner; do git show "e28dc036:.github/workflows/$f.yml" > /tmp/wf-$f.yml; n=$(grep -c -F 'steps.plugins.outputs.plugin_marketplaces' /tmp/wf-$f.yml); v=$(grep -c -F 'steps.vendor_marketplace.outputs.plugin_marketplaces' /tmp/wf-$f.yml); echo "$f.yml: plugins-step=$n vendor-step=$v"; done
for f in devflow-implement devflow devflow-runner; do git show e28dc036:.github/workflows/$f.yml > /tmp/wf-$f.yml; done; echo done

git show e28dc036:.github/workflows/devflow-implement.yml > /tmp/a.yml; git show e28dc036:.github/workflows/devflow.yml > /tmp/b.yml; git show e28dc036:.github/workflows/devflow-runner.yml > /tmp/c.yml; echo extracted

git show e28dc036:.github/workflows/devflow-implement.yml > .prflow/tmp/a.yml && git show e28dc036:.github/workflows/devflow.yml > .prflow/tmp/b.yml && git show e28dc036:.github/workflows/devflow-runner.yml > .prflow/tmp/c.yml && echo ok

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
